# `Ui.Grid`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Ui.Grid — explicit CSS-grid track lists for `Ipe.Ui`.

Typed `Track` ADT (`fr / px / auto / minContent / maxContent /
minmax / repeat / repeatAutoFit / repeatAutoFill`) + `columns`
/ `rows` / `tracks` attribute builders.  Use when `Ui.gridColumns
N` (auto-fill) is too coarse — sidebar layouts (`[fr 1, px 200,
fr 1]`), content-aware columns (`[auto, fr 1]`), responsive card
grids (`[repeatAutoFit (minmax (px 240) (fr 1))]`).
